issues.title: Allow tiles to be pulled from `data` folder
issues.body:
For the next wargame the players have a 450Mb folder of tiles, down to a small resolution.  We can't _build_ this into Serge like we do with the current `public` folder.

For our `executable` instance of Serge, when it is first run, it unpacks a `data` folder, and gets its data from there.

So, we need to modify the `server.js` so that it is able to get tiles from the `data` folder.  It's ok for us to provide a new API for this. Maybe `\tiles\:folder\:z\:y\:x.png` (or however it's constructed :-) ).

This will be the `success` for this issue:
- run `pkg-build` to create self-installing Serge
- run `serge.exe` (or whatever it is called)
- note that `serge\data` folder has been created
- from Serge sources, copy a tile-map from `client\public` folder (such as `atlantic_tiles`) into `data`
- rename tile-map folder to be `test_tiles`
- open serge wargame `wargame-l6nngxlk.sqlite`
- find latest wargame (`infotype`)
- navigate to `planning channel`, and change the `tileLayer.url` to be `"./test_tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png",`
- run the wargame, navigate to the atlantic, check the tiles are shown
